verdict.rationale: Ollama's docs explicitly name an official Python library and JavaScript/TypeScript library for calling Ollama from applications. These sit on top of a documented REST API. The evidence is only brief one-line mentions, though, with no detail on what the libraries cover. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of library API coverage (chat, generate, model management, streaming), independent or hands-on corroboration of the client libraries, and evidence of libraries in languages beyond Python and JS.
